3.6.9 \((1+x)^{a}=1+ax+\frac{\alpha(\alpha-1)}{2!}\,x^{2}+\frac{\alpha(\alpha-1)(\alpha-2 )}{3!}\,x^{3}+\,\ldots\,,\) \((1+x)^{-i}=1-\frac{1}{3}\,x+\frac{2}{9}\,x^{2}-\frac{14}{81}\,x^{3}+\frac{35}{243} \,x^{4}\) \(-\frac{91}{729}\,x^{3}+\frac{728}{6561}\,x^{6}-\,\ldots\,\) \((-1<x<1)\) Asymptotic Expansions

3.6.15A series \(\sum\limits_{k=0}^{\infty}a_{k}x^{-k}\) is said to be an asymptotic expansion of a function \(f(x)\) if

\[f(x)-\sum\limits_{k=0}^{n-1}a_{k}x^{-k}=O(x^{-n})\mbox{ as $x\to\infty$}\]

for every \(n=1,2\), \(\ldots\). We write

\[f(x)\sim\sum\limits_{k=0}^{\infty}a_{k}x^{-k}\,.\]

The series itself may be either convergent or divergent.

ELEMENTARY ANALYTICAL METHODS (p.15)
Binomial Series
3.6.9  (1+x)^n=\sum_{k=0}^{\infty}\binom{n}{k}x^k \quad (|x|<1)
3.6.10  (1+x)^{-n}=\sum_{k=0}^{\infty}(-1)^k\binom{n+k-1}{k}x^k \quad (|x|<1)
3.6.11  \binom{n}{k}=\frac{n(n-1)\cdots(n-k+1)}{k!}
3.6.12  (1+x)^{1/2}=1+\tfrac12 x-\tfrac18 x^2+\tfrac1{16}x^3-\tfrac{5}{128}x^4+\cdots \quad (|x|<1)
3.6.13  (1+x)^{-1/2}=1-\tfrac12 x+\tfrac38 x^2-\tfrac{5}{16}x^3+\tfrac{35}{128}x^4-\cdots \quad (|x|<1)
3.6.14  (1-x)^{-1}=1+x+x^2+x^3+\cdots \quad (|x|<1)
3.6.15  (1-x)^{-2}=1+2x+3x^2+4x^3+\cdots \quad (|x|<1)
Operations With Power Series
If f(x)=\sum a_nx^n and g(x)=\sum b_nx^n then
3.6.16  f(x)+g(x)=\sum(a_n+b_n)x^n
3.6.17  f(x)g(x)=\sum c_nx^n,\quad c_n=\sum_{k=0}^{n}a_kb_{n-k}
3.6.18  f(x)/g(x)=\sum d_nx^n,\quad a_n=\sum_{k=0}^{n}d_kb_{n-k}\ (b_0\neq0)
3.6.19  f'(x)=\sum na_nx^{n-1}
3.6.20  \int_0^x f(t)dt=\sum \frac{a_n}{n+1}x^{n+1}
3.6.21  [f(x)]^{-1}\ \mathrm{reversion:\ if}\ y=\sum a_nx^n\ (a_0=0,a_1\neq0),\ \mathrm{then}\ x=\sum b_ny^n
3.6.22  b_1=1/a_1
3.6.23  b_2=-a_2/a_1^3
3.6.24  b_3=(2a_2^2-a_1a_3)/a_1^5
